pr_title: *: add label check for create placement policy
pr_body:
<!-- Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: partial close #26580

### What is changed and how it works?

What's Changed:
when create placement policy name ???_constraints=[`label1`=vakue], constraints=[`label2`=value], the common constraints is actually appended to the previous constraints. 

This way, after the check of compatibility, we should also check the `label existence` in the storage via access PD api, which is already included in `show placement labels`

### Check List <!--REMOVE the items that are not applicable-->

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- [x] Manual test (add detailed scripts or steps below)

```
script
1: start a real cluster:
tiup playground 5.1.1 --tiflash 0  --db 2 --db.binpath  ~/go/src/github.com/pingcap/tidb/bin/tidb-server

2: restart the tikv node with labels:
/tikv-server --addr=127.0.0.1:20160 --advertise-addr=127.0.0.1:20160 --status-addr=127.0.0.1:20180 --pd=http://127.0.0.1:2379 --config=/home/arenatlx/.tiup/data/Shjeocq/tikv-0/tikv.toml --data-dir=/home/arenatlx/.tiup/data/Shjeocq/tikv-0/data --log-file=/home/arenatlx/.tiup/data/Shjeocq/tikv-0/tikv.log --labels zone=beijing,rack=huawei,host=local,disk=ssd

3: test show placement label can work:
mysql> show placement labels;
+------+-------------+
| Key  | Values      |
+------+-------------+
| disk | ["ssd"]     |
| host | ["local"]   |
| rack | ["huawei"]  |
| zone | ["beijing"] |
+------+-------------+
4 rows in set (0.01 sec)

4: test create placement policy with vaild labels:
mysql> create placement policy x followers 2 follower_constraints="[+disk=ssd]" constraints="[+zone=beijing]";
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.53 sec)

5: test create placement policy with invalid labels:
mysql> create placement policy x1 followers 2 follower_constraints="[+disk=ssd]" constraints="[+zone1=beijing]";
ERROR 1105 (HY000): Placement label zone1 doesn't exist in the storage
```

### Release note <!-- bugfixes or new feature need a release note -->

```release-note
None
```

issue_context.title: Support named PLACEMENT POLICY
issue_context.body:
This is a sub-task of Placement Rules in SQL: https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/18030

Support the ability to `CREATE PLACEMENT POLICY` with the same options available in `CREATE TABLE|ALTER TABLE` context.

The following subtasks are known:

* [x] Parser: {CREATE|ALTER} PLACEMENT POLICY placement_options https://github.com/pingcap/parser/pull/1313
* [x] Parser: SHOW CREATE PLACEMENT POLICY x, DROP PLACEMENT POLICY [IF EXISTS] x; https://github.com/pingcap/parser/pull/1295 https://github.com/pingcap/parser/pull/1298
* [x] Design table in mysql.* for persisting placement policies. https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/27251
* [x] Ensure {CREATE|ALTER|DROP} PLACEMENT POLICY requires the PLACEMENT_ADMIN privilege https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/27603
* [x] #27714
* [x] ALTER PLACEMENT POLICY should update placement rules for all tables in scope in PD.
* [x] DROP PLACEMENT POLICY should clear the placement rules for all tables in scope in PD, and reset the `SHOW CREATE TABLE` info to no longer have the placement policy named.
comments:
